### Available skills
- repo-foundation: Add features, start modules, migrate contracts, or pick up half-finished work without breaking the public API. Use for "add X to this project", "set up a new module", "change this schema", "migrate the database", "continue where we left off", "fix this bug", "split this module". (file: r0/repo-foundation/SKILL.md)
- repo-native-refactor: Review a diff or PR without editing it, or tidy a change set without changing behavior. Use for "review my changes", "check this diff for contract breaks", "clean this up before I open a PR", "is this safe", "merge the duplicates". (file: r0/repo-native-refactor/SKILL.md)
